svg.desc: Rehabilitation and Construction of Factories in Dakahlya LOCATION Dakahlya, Egypt CLIENT Cotton & Textile Industries Holding Co. COMPLETION EST. VALUE 2024 700 million EGP DISCIPLINES Architectural Design Electrical Engineering Mechanical Engineering Project Overview This completed 700 million EGP project in Mansoura, Dakahlya, involves the rehabilitation and construction of Detex Co. for Spinning & Weaving factories. Services include reviewing detailed and execution drawings (architectural, structural, electrical, and mechanical), supervising works, monitoring quality and HSE compliance, approving materials and work receipts, and controlling costs according to schedule.
